verdict.rationale: three.js is a code-first JavaScript library: scenes, cameras, geometry, materials, renderers, loaders and controls are all created and driven programmatically (gh-4, gh-1, docs-2, docs-4, docs-5). Agents use it directly through npm, guided by the machine-readable llms.txt and llms-full.txt docs (probe-rt-2). Because the library is the API, the only UI surface is the separate three.js editor (docs-7). Missing for 10: explicit evidence that every three.js editor feature (e.g. scene import/export, project publishing) is reachable through the library API, and independent hands-on corroboration of that parity.
